## Main projects

#### [NICE — Neural Integration for Constitutive Equations](https://github.com/filippo-masi/NICE)

A deep-learning framework for the automatic discovery of constitutive equations from small, sparse and incomplete material-state observations.

#### [Thermodynamics-based Artificial Neural Networks](https://github.com/filippo-masi/Thermodynamics-Neural-Networks)

Reference implementation of thermodynamics-based neural architectures for constitutive modelling of inelastic materials.

#### [TANN-multiscale](https://github.com/filippo-masi/TANN-multiscale)

Micromechanical simulations, training workflows and finite-element examples for multiscale modelling of inelastic materials with TANN.

#### [Constitutive transport learning](https://github.com/filippo-masi/constitutive-transport-learning)

Hard-constrained thermodynamic learning of inelastic constitutive models from stress–strain data through generalised transport operators.
